oneLine: Iron Dome launches are trailer-grade (thick, lit, billowing ribbons), but ribbon geometry breaks up when it is edge-on or close to the camera, Arrow and Sling engagements read as small fireworks with round halo blobs, and the aftermath and ballistic-impact smoke lack scale. An env console error in the current build also caps the score at 6.
strengths: C3/S3 Iron Dome launches: thick, curving, widening smoke ribbons with a warm motor glow, a ground billow at the battery and a launch flash that lights the terrain. This is the closest to WARNO / Broken Arrow vocabulary in the slice (C3 frame f00108).
Smoke is lit (albedo x moon, VFX point lights and town glow) rather than being flat additive puffs. Trails pick up the launch flash and read as pale smoke against the night sky.
Ballistic re-entry heads are long, hot, orange meteor streaks (C4, C5). Overhead in C4 they are the most dramatic image in the slice.
The S9 ground impact has a proper billowing cloud with a dust skirt, a fire-lit base and a persistent smoke trail down from the sky.
Burning debris falls in arcs with glowing trails and spark breakups (S5, C1).

The code is clean and on budget: about 10 VFX draw calls (2 point pools, 2 trail sets, scorch, 5 instanced bodies), VFX update 0.2 to 0.9 ms, typed-array ring buffers, seeded RNG, no per-frame allocations, and no shot-specific hacks.

issues.text: Ribbon trails twist into flat bow-tie fins with bright seam lines when a trail points toward the camera (S3: the descending trail at the centre corkscrews into visible triangles). The big launch plume shows straight polygon edges on its left flank. Both are the 'primitives' tell that TARGET.md calls out.
issues.fix: In trails.js VERT, cross(tv, mv.xyz) degenerates as the tangent aligns with the view ray. Compute f = abs(dot(normalize(tv), normalize(mv.xyz))). As f goes from 0.85 to 0.98, blend the side vector toward a stable screen-space perpendicular (cross(viewDir, previous side), or pass a per-vertex aPrevSide), widen the ribbon by 1/(1-f+eps), clamped, and fade alpha. Also emit 1 or 2 alpha smoke puffs (smoke pool, T_SMOKE) per committed trail point when f > 0.9, so edge-on sections read as volume. For the hard flank edges, raise the fbm erosion amplitude in FRAG_SMOKE (e = abs(v) + (n-0.5)*(0.7+0.75*vA.y)) and lower the dens smoothstep outer edge to about 0.85, so no fragment at |v|~1 survives.

issues.text: Near the camera, a smoke ribbon renders as a flat, hard-edged grey slab with a square end cap (C5 and S9, lower left). An interceptor's motor streak and a star flash with a hard circular halo edge pass right by the lens at t~253.6.
issues.fix: trails.js: (1) taper both ends of every ribbon. In update(), multiply alpha and hw by smoothstep(0, 2*seg, S[j]-S[first]) and by smoothstep(0, 2*seg, S[last]-S[j]) for dead trails (al==0), so an ended trail never shows a square cap. (2) Add near-camera fade in VERT: vA.x *= smoothstep(hw*1.5, hw*6.0, dz). (3) Add a second, higher-frequency noise octave keyed to screen-space width, so a close ribbon still billows. particles.js FRAG_FIRE ty==2: the exp(-r*3)*0.12 term is about 0.006*vC at r=1, so it is cut by the discard into a visible disc. Multiply col by smoothstep(1.0, 0.6, r) for every type.

issues.text: Arrow 3 exo intercepts (C1, S6) are a sparse cluster of orange re-entry streaks plus a white core inside a large, smooth, round glow disc. They read as fireworks or a lens blob, not a brilliant star-flash over the Dead Sea. The glint cross is almost invisible at 960px. The Arrow climb trails show only as faint blue vertical bands in the upper right, more like searchlight beams than smoke.
issues.fix: index.js exo branch: drop or shrink the T_GLOW halo (900 to 1700 m, alpha 0.45) to about 40% size, and give it a fast 0.25 s decay so it does not linger as a disc. In FRAG_FIRE ty==2, make the spikes respect a minimum length in pixels (sh = clamp(vPx*0.6, 6, 90) is too wide at small vPx). Draw the cross as 2 thin screen-space streaks about 60 to 120 px long whatever the distance, with uMinPx about 24 for T_STAR. Add a short-lived expanding debris shell: about 30 T_GLOW sparks with cool>0 that linger 3 to 5 s, plus a faint white smoke ring (T_SMOKE, alpha 0.15) at 25 km, so each kill leaves a mark. For the Arrow boost-phase ribbons (ST.arrow.smoke), raise alpha to about 1.0, raise the minPx for that set, and light them more strongly with uAmb so they read as lit trails, not blue bands.

issues.text: Overhead (C4, S5), the David's Sling trails are thin, pale, scribbled lines. This is the 'trails as thin lines' failure sign, at the signature moment over the town. The Sling intercepts themselves show as round bloom glows with almost no visible fireball or lingering smoke puff.
issues.fix: ST.sling.smoke: these legs are 8 to 15 km up, so w0/w1 of 12/70 m projects to a few px. Make width grow with altitude (w *= 1 + y/4000) or with distance from the camera, so the screen width stays at least 6 to 10 px for the first ~3 s. Raise the 'boost' segment. For endo intercepts above 6 km, scale Rf with camDist (Rf *= clamp(d/4000, 1, 3)) so the noise fireball and smoke puff stay at least 40 px. Spawn 4 to 6 extra lingering T_SMOKE puffs, shaded darker (smokeAlb 0.3), so a grey smudge stays where each kill happened.

issues.text: S7 aftermath has almost no VFX presence. One faint wispy column with a flat pale dust disc, plus small fires along the escarpment. No tall smoke columns rise over the Negev to sell what happened, whereas CoH3 and WARNO post-battle frames are full of drifting smoke. The S9 ballistic impact cloud is a uniformly orange-lit cotton lump, with no dark smoke above the lit base.
issues.fix: index.js columns: make the ballistic column taller and longer lasting (puff vy 40 to 70*s, s1 up to 600*s, life 45 to 60 s). Let the top puffs spread laterally with wind (they already lean). Darken the albedo with height (0.27 -> 0.12 above 300 m) and set vAux.y (internal warmth) only for puffs within 80 m of the base, so the column is dark and lit from below. Also add a minimum-pixel growth term for distant columns (uMinPx is 1.3 for smoke), so from the S7 high camera a column holds at least 25 to 40 px wide. Ring dust (T_DUST from impact): add fbm erosion in the dust ring pass or reduce alpha to about 0.3, so it is not a flat ellipse.

issues.text: The ballistic smoke trail (S9, C5) is a perfectly straight, uniform-width, uniformly lit tan band that reads like a searchlight beam rather than turbulent smoke. In C4 the hot ribbons are constant-width laser lines.
issues.fix: ST.ballistic.smoke: raise turb from 5 to about 25, add segGrow/WK variation (0.5 to 1.5), set warm>0 only near the head, and add per-point alpha breakup (AK *= 0.6 + 0.4*noise) so the column fragments. ST.ballistic.hot: taper w over the trail and add flicker in FRAG_HOT along vA.z, so the streak sputters rather than reading as a laser.

issues.text: Drone kills over the escarpment at 3 to 5 km (C3, S3) are ~10 px orange pops. The flash does not light the nearby trails or terrain enough to register as an event at RTS tactical zoom.
issues.fix: index.js intercept: scale Rf and the T_STAR size by max(1, camDist/2500)^0.5. Raise addLight radius (Rf*3.5 -> Rf*8) so the nearest smoke ribbons visibly flash orange. Lower uMinPx-driven alpha falloff for T_FIREBALL (FRAG_FIRE uses vA = a*k*k for additive), so distant fireballs keep energy.

issues.text: Per-frame follow glows call fire.add(), which draws rng.next() for the sprite seed. RNG consumption therefore depends on frame count: the same sim time renders different explosion shapes at 12 fps (clips) versus the shot seek. Each command is reproducible on its own, but clips and shots of the same moment disagree.
issues.evidence: src/vfx/index.js glow() -> particles.js add() seed = this.rand()
issues.fix: Give follow glows (life<0) a deterministic seed from the entity id (e.g. fract(id*0.618)) instead of rng, or use a separate rng stream for cosmetic seeds, so event-driven bursts consume rng independently of frame rate.

issues.text: Every shot logs '[slice] env.update failed TypeError: hemi.color.copy(...).addScaledVector is not a function' (src/env/index.js:131, edited mid-run at 00:25 UTC). The clips rendered before that edit were clean. Per protocol, this caps the score at 6. Env lighting (flash response) was not running for the shots.
issues.fix: Not vfx-owned. In env/index.js, THREE.Color has no addScaledVector: use hemi.color.copy(hemiBase).add(tmpColor.copy(flashCol).multiplyScalar(0.35)). VFX should re-run shots once env is fixed.

benchmarkNotes: WARNO / Broken Arrow: the Iron Dome launch-and-climb in C3 is in the same vocabulary as their SAM launches (thick lit trails that drift and widen). It is let down by ribbon-twist fins and hard flank edges that those games never show. Their high-altitude engagements leave visible lingering smudges and bright, sharp flashes. Here the Arrow (C1/S6) and Sling (C4/S5) engagements are small, sparse and halo-blobby, and Sling trails are hairlines. CoH3: impacts there have a dark, heavy column rising out of a lit base with debris and lingering smoke. The S9 cloud has the shape but is uniformly orange-lit with no dark column, and the S7 aftermath has nothing like CoH3's post-battle smoke. Iron Harvest: lighting interplay on the C3 launch (flash lighting the ground billow and trail) is at that level. Overall this is a competent, cohesive system with one trailer-worthy moment (the C3 launch). The canonical S6/S7 shots and the near-camera ribbon artifacts keep it below 7 on merit as well as under the console-error cap.
